requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4770-4924--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Heartless Summoning.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-4924--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1339-1496-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-1496-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-2829-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2829-4694-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-3025-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1818-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1011-2728-4050-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-4050-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-4050-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

178-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1362-1479-2783.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

891-2292-4775.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1329-4779-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-4779-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

323-4681-5170-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-647-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

625-1978-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
625-1978-4747.description:
Cause Alena to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat from step 2.

1182-4616-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2100-2633-5644.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

2634-5148-5957.notablePrerequisites:
Kianne's power is odd.
You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2634-5148-5957.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

413-3719-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
413-3719-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

4702-6188.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Fear of Missing Out.
4702-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out does not have summoning sickness.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
4702-6188.description:
Activate Fear of Missing Out by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker, triggering its ability, untapping the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

575-5147-5971.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
575-5147-5971.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When the creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

282-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Delina.
282-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Coretapper that is tapped and attacking.
Activate a Coretapper token's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
If you control any other Coretapper tokens, you may repeat step 4 as desired for each of them.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-3220-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
2034-3220-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Golgari Germination and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

277-835-1737-2092-2544.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
277-835-1737-2092-2544.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Tanglepool Bridge.
When Tanglepool Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Tanglepool Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

73-575-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Daru Mender, adding {W}.
When Daru Mender dies, Yedora triggers, returning Daru Mender from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Daru Mender by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Daru Mender's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

575-4050-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-4050-4674.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Temur Charger, adding one mana of any color.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
